why: Issue #529 verbatim: the last --only occurrence wins and every earlier one is discarded. `--only a --only b --only c` then runs one entry and reports "1/1 mutation(s) ran ... 0 mismatch(es)", a line no reader can tell from a clean sweep of all three. Assignment is exactly what this flag did before the fix, so this is the regression the accumulation exists to prevent rather than an invented one.
killedBy: parseArgs ACCUMULATES repeated --only instead of keeping the last one (issue #529)
